finding.title: Clear partial scope when global initialization throws
finding.serviceFinding: sdk.Initialize() can throw after scope is assigned but before scopes registration or client ownership. The same provider's next acquisition sees non-null scope, skips global initialization, and attempts package work against an uninitialized SDK; retryable SdkFailure cannot recover without recreating the provider.
finding.requestedCorrection: Assign scope only after successful initialization/registration, or clear the partial scope on failure, so a later explicit retry can initialize correctly.
finding.attribution: Independent service finding; not locally reproduced or supplemented.
